card.name: Co- at start of co-administered
card.fires_on: The first piece of 'coadministration' or 'co-administered' (co, Co, Coad, coform), and 'shared' in the sense of 'together with'. It fires in drug-interaction text, right before the word continues into 'administered with'.

modes.label: Co-administration start
